body:
OWNER REASSERTION: the served site is better but still extremely thin. I inspected the HTML at http://127.0.0.1:8765/scala/getting-started/. Exact scope: one executable-looking StorySource to SurfaceAnalyzer path; span queries; then a WOG snippet that prints no expected values and performs no story-recall comparison. The site has no runnable GraphHsmm, RecallSignature, interview, codec, feature, or view workflow and no figure. scala/modules is an inventory, not evidence of use. The current title Inspect a source document is accurate; it is not a meaningful first success for this library.

The one-sentence product claim the docs must prove is: storymodel4s turns evidence-backed story and recall structures into an auditable partial probabilistic alignment, distinguishing faithful recall, named distortions, reordering, omission, and material outside the source, then derives research summaries that carry support and missingness. It also supports typed acquisition, numerical sidecars, autobiographical-interview scoring, canonical persistence, and evidence-preserving views. It does not yet turn arbitrary raw prose into a complete model unattended.

Required ordinary-work spine, not more module prose:
1. MODEL A STORY: WOG source to exact spans, claims, speech/belief contexts, situations, hierarchy, world-time and causal edges. Show quoted evidence plus a context/story graph.
2. REPRESENT RECALL: transcript to checked recall units, functions, uncertainty and recall relations. Print the exact units.
3. ALIGN AND INTERPRET: run CandidateGenerator and GraphHsmm, show exact top-k posterior rows, named external states, distorted facets and Viterbi path. Include a recall-by-source heatmap and a discourse/world/recall timeline.
4. SUMMARIZE WITHOUT LAUNDERING MISSINGNESS: run RecallSignature.compute; print exact value plus support/conditioning mass, include one real abstention, and plot coverage, fidelity, chronology, causal preservation and external mass without turning n/a into zero.
5. SCORE AN INTERVIEW: Birthday fixture to detail evidence, memory addresses, traditional counts and rich profile, with exact output and one profile plot.
6. SAVE AND DELIVER: StoryModelCodec round-trip/checksum plus a failed decode; then the output bundle with separate model, renderer and bundle outcomes. Generated result must remain self-contained pure HTML/CSS, no JavaScript or external resources, and filesystem-openable.

Every guide acceptance: complete public imports and setup; deterministic input; the exact snippet compiled or executed; captured exact output from that same program; plain-language interpretation; one material failure or limitation; focused evidence; one accessible static figure only where it explains a relationship. Checked-in numbers or SVGs need an identity link to the producer and exact SHA, not hand transcription.

A real blocker exposed by explanation: AnnaFixture is in align test source, while the WOG end-to-end alignment harness and synonym resource are private test helpers. The current public WOG model alone does not provide a short ordinary alignment program. We must either authorize one small public deterministic demonstration facade in fixtures, or add a docs-only executable consumer that shows all setup without changing production vocabulary. Copying internal helpers into prose is not acceptable. This support decision should be part of the successor docs assignment and gate.

The Astro/Starlight documentation site and the generated scientific output bundle are distinct artifacts. The pure HTML/CSS rule binds the latter; static SVG figures also let the docs explain the library without requiring runtime JavaScript.
